newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ranger awards US$119 mln mine contract.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ranger awards US$119 mln mine contract.

text.p: Australia-listed miner Ranger Minerals NL said on Tuesday its 90 percent owned Abosso Goldfields Ltd unit has awarded a five-year mining contract for the Damang gold mine in Ghana, Africa to a 50-50 joint venture between Eltin Ltd and Ausdrill Ltd.

The open pit-type mine was scheduled to commence production in the fourth quarter of 1997 and produced about 270,000 ounces annually for at least seven years, Rod Martson, a director of Ranger told Reuters.
The mine life could be extended due to further exploration work, Marston said.
Last November, Eltin and Ausdrill were jointly awarded a mining services contact for the Tarkwa gold mine in Ghana valued at A$135 million.
